lines: EndSpeech: Quando você passa pelas estátuas ativadas o alarme soa.

list.text: Go ahead, take another step.\nWe've got explosives set in the floor!\nStep on one, and--BOOM!
Where are the traps planted?\nThat... Well...
This was once a ninja hideout.
There are traps to confound intruders like you.
The PC on my desk is the switch that deactivates the PERSIAN alarm system.
The red switch is flashing in a suspicious manner.\nWill you press it?
